name: Nicole Haliday
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I work with individuals and couples experiencing anxiety, relationship challenges and significant life transitions. Many of the people I support are navigating periods of uncertainty, whether that involves changes in relationships, family dynamics, career direction, loss, or a growing sense that life no longer feels quite as it once did. My approach is calm, thoughtful and collaborative.

name: Poojaben Patel
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Finding a therapist who can deeply attune to you and creatively integrate approaches that truly align with your needs can be really hard. It often takes energy from every part of your life- especially when you’re already running on empty. I have 13 years of experience working in mental health industry and wide range of communities.
